items.title: Albert Nicholas Interview, 1972-06-26
items.q: He started arranging two numbers first a week, and he knew the band's sound.

ctx.x: He was a great guy. He was a great guy. How did you get it? How did you get it?
Well, through the years, you know what I mean, when everything was happening. He started arranging two numbers first a week, and he knew the band's sound.
